recipe.name: Chicken Lime Rice Bowl with Black Beans
steps: Cook the rice according to package instructions.
Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and cumin. Cook the chicken until fully cooked.
Juice the limes and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine cooked rice, sliced cooked chicken, drained black beans, and lime juice.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with additional lime wedges if desired.

recipe.name: Spicy Chicken Fajitas with Black Beans and Lime Rice
steps: Marinate the chicken in a spicy marinade made with lime juice, chili powder, garlic, and oil.
Cook the rice according to package instructions, adding lime zest and salt to taste.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add some oil and cook the marinated chicken until cooked through.
Add sliced bell peppers and onions to the same skillet, cooking until softened.
Stir in the cooked chicken, black beans, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the chicken fajita mixture over the prepared lime rice.

recipe.name: Chickpea and Tomato Stew
steps: Chop the onion and tomatoes.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Heat some olive oil in a large pot. Sauté the onion until translucent.
Add tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in chickpeas, season with salt, pepper, and your choice of spices such as cumin or paprika.
Simmer for about 30 minutes.

recipe.name: Spiced Chickpea and Tomato Stew
steps: Rinse and drain the chickpeas.
Chop the onion and tomatoes.
Sauté the onion in a large pot over medium heat until translucent.
Add chopped tomatoes, chickpeas, 2 cloves minced garlic, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp paprika, and a pinch of red pepper flakes (adjust to taste for spiciness).
Stir well, cover the pot, and let it simmer for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipe.name: Beef and Sour Cream Onion Dip
steps: Cook the beef until browned and drain off any excess fat.
Finely chop the onions and sauté them in a pan until they are soft.
Mix the cooked beef and sautéed onions with the sour cream.

recipe.name: Beef Tacos with Sour Cream and Spicy Onion
steps: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside. In the same skillet, sauté the onions with a tablespoon of oil until they are translucent and slightly caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add minced jalapeños (optional for spiciness) to the onions and cook for another minute.
Return the beef to the skillet, stir in the cooked onions and combine well.
Warm corn or flour tortillas.
Divide the beef mixture among the tortillas.
Top each taco with a dollop of sour cream.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, diced tomatoes, and lime wedges.

recipe.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Cook the spaghetti according to package instructions and drain.
In a large pan, brown the ground beef over medium heat until cooked through.
Add diced tomatoes, salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Toss the cooked spaghetti in the meat sauce.
Serve hot with grated Parmesan cheese and fresh basil leaves.

recipe.name: Spicy Beef Spaghetti
steps: Cook the spaghetti according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, brown the ground beef over medium heat. Drain excess fat.
Dice the tomatoes and add them to the skillet along with 2 tbsp of tomato paste.
Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and crushed red pepper flakes (to taste, depending on desired spiciness).
Stir in cooked spaghetti.

recipe.name: Shrimp Scampi over Linguine
steps: Cook the linguine according to package instructions.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add shrimp and cook until pink, about 3-4 minutes.
Drain pasta and add to the skillet with the shrimp.
Season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice.
Toss to coat evenly and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Spicy Shrimp Linguine
steps: Cook the linguine according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add crushed red pepper flakes (to taste) and sauté for 30 seconds.
Season the shrimp with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add shrimp to the skillet and cook until pink and opaque, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove skillet from heat and stir in a squeeze of lemon juice.

recipe.name: Spaghetti al Pomodoro
steps: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
Chop tomatoes and basil leaves.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Add chopped tomatoes, salt, pepper, and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in basil leaves just before serving.

recipe.name: Spicy Tomato Basil Pasta
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook according to package instructions until al dente.
Drain the cooked pasta, reserving some pasta water.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add 2 tbsp of olive oil.
Add halved cherry tomatoes and sauté for 5 minutes or until they begin to soften.
Stir in 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp crushed red pepper flakes (adjust based on preference), salt, and black pepper. Cook for another minute.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet, tossing to combine with the sauce.
Stir in chopped fresh basil leaves and a splash of reserved pasta water if needed.

recipe.name: Chicken Curry with Rice
steps: Clean and cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Cook the rice according to package instructions.
Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring continuously.
Stir in chicken pieces and cook until browned on all sides.
Add your choice of canned coconut milk, tomato sauce, or broth to cover the chicken.
Simmer for 20 minutes, or until chicken is fully cooked.
Season with salt and pepper if needed.

recipe.name: Chicken Curry with Rice
steps: Wash the rice and set it aside.
Chop the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped chicken and cook until browned.
Reduce heat to low, add 2 tbsp curry powder, stirring constantly for 1 minute to toast the spices.
Add 3 cups of water (or chicken broth) and bring to a boil.
Stir in the rice, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 15 minutes or until the rice is cooked.
Adjust seasoning with salt if needed.

recipe.name: Stir-fried Vegetable Rice with Soy Sauce
steps: Cook rice according to package instructions.
Chop carrots and peas into bite-sized pieces.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add 2 tbsp of oil.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for 5 minutes or until slightly tender.
Add the peas and cook for another 3 minutes.
Stir in cooked rice and soy sauce. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Serve hot.

recipe.name: Stir-fried Vegetable Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper Red Bell Pepper (sliced)
1 jalapeno Jalapeno (finely chopped, seeds removed if desired for less heat)
steps: Cook the rice according to package instructions.
Prepare all vegetables as indicated.
Heat a large wok or skillet over high heat. Add 2 tbsp of oil (olive, sesame or peanut oil).
Add minced ginger and garlic, sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add sliced red bell pepper and finely chopped jalapeno. Sauté for 2 minutes.
Add carrots and peas. Stir-fry for another 3 minutes until slightly tender.
Add soy sauce and stir to coat the vegetables evenly.
Gently fold in cooked rice. Cook for an additional minute to combine flavors.

recipe.name: Vegetable Sesame Tofu Stir Fry
steps: Cook noodles according to package instructions.
Drain and set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp of sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add tofu and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Remove from skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add soy sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Add cooked noodles to the skillet, tossing to coat with the sauce.
Return the tofu to the skillet and mix well.
Serve hot.

recipe.name: Spicy Sesame Tofu Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles according to package instructions and drain.
Cut the tofu into cubes.
In a bowl, mix 3 tbsp sesame oil, soy sauce, and 2 tbsp of your favorite hot sauce (adjust to taste). Add the cubed tofu and let marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Remove tofu from marinade, reserving marinade. Cook the tofu until browned on all sides.
Add remaining sesame oil to the skillet and cook the noodles for 2-3 minutes.
Pour in the reserved marinade and cook for another 2-3 minutes, coating the noodles evenly.
Return the tofu to the skillet and toss everything together.

recipe.name: Chicken and Rice with Paprika
steps: Chop the chicken and onion.
Cook the rice according to package instructions.
Heat oil in a pan, add chopped chicken and cook until browned.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened.
Stir in cooked rice, 1 tsp of paprika, salt, and pepper to taste.
Serve hot.

recipe.name: Spicy Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice according to package instructions.
Chop the onion and set aside.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add 1 tbsp of oil.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken pieces and season with salt, pepper, and 1 tbsp paprika. Cook until browned, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the cooked rice and mix well.
Add 1 tbsp of soy sauce, 2 tsp of sriracha (for spiciness), and another tbsp of oil if needed. Stir well to combine.
Cook for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

recipe.name: Chipotle-Style Chicken Burrito Bowl
ingredients: 2 Cans of black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: In a bowl, combine chicken, olive oil, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
Heat a grill or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the seasoned chicken and cook for about 7 minutes on each side or until fully cooked.
Once done, let it rest for a few minutes before slicing.
Divide rice evenly among four bowls.
Add sliced chicken, black beans, diced tomatoes, and shredded lettuce on top of the rice.
Top each bowl with shredded cheese, sour cream, salsa, avocado slices, a squeeze of lime juice, and any other toppings you prefer.

recipe.name: Spicy Chicken Fajita Burrito Bowl
ingredients: 1-2 tsp cayenne pepper (adjust for desired spiciness)
salt to taste black pepper, ground
steps: In a large bowl, whisk together cumin, paprika, chili powder, cayenne pepper, salt, black pepper, and lime juice.
Add chicken to the marinade, tossing until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes (or up to overnight for more flavor).
Thinly slice the bell pepper, onion, and garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook for 7 minutes per side or until cooked through.
Remove chicken from the skillet, let it rest, then slice it thinly. Set aside.
In the same skillet, add sliced bell pepper, onion, and garlic. Cook for about 5 minutes or until softened.
Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet with the vegetables, tossing to combine.
Divide rice into 4 bowls. Add a portion of chicken and vegetable mixture on top.
Add shredded lettuce, salsa, cheese, and sour cream (if using).

recipe.name: Thai Green Curry
ingredients: 4 Chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 cup Green beans, trimmed and halved
1 red bell pepper, sliced Red bell pepper
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sliced onion, sauté until softened.
Add chicken pieces and cook until browned.
Stir in Thai green curry paste, cook for 2 minutes.
Pour coconut milk into the pan and stir well.
Add fish sauce and sugar. Stir until sugar dissolves.
Add green beans and red bell pepper, simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in Thai basil leaves, remove from heat.

recipe.name: Thai Green Curry with Fresh Basil
steps: Slice chicken into thin strips
Halve zucchinis lengthwise and slice thickly
Chop bell pepper, onion, and garlic
Heat curry paste in a large pan over medium heat for 1 minute
Add coconut milk, chicken, zucchinis, bell pepper, onion, and garlic. Simmer until chicken is cooked through (about 10-12 minutes)
Stir in lime juice, fish sauce, brown sugar, and red pepper flakes
Stir in basil leaves just before serving
Serve over steamed jasmine rice, garnished with green onions
